name: Launch sync (English, synthetic)
title: Q4 launch sync
transcript:
Ana Ruiz: Morning all. Quick recap of where we are with the Q4 launch.
Bob Chen: Engineering is mostly on track. The billing integration is the one thing I'm worried about, Stripe's new invoicing API is still in beta and it's been flaky in staging.
Ana Ruiz: How flaky?
Bob Chen: A few timeouts a day. If it doesn't stabilise we could slip a week.
Carla Diaz: Marketing had the 15th of October in all the drafts. Are we keeping that?
Ana Ruiz: Let's decide now. I'd rather launch on the 22nd and not rush billing. Everyone ok with the 22nd?
Dan Park: Fine by me.
Bob Chen: Yes, the 22nd gives us room.
Ana Ruiz: Great, so we're moving the launch to October 22nd instead of the 15th.
Carla Diaz: Then I'll update the press kit and the landing page dates by Wednesday.
Ana Ruiz: Thanks. Bob, can you get a fallback plan for billing, like manual invoices for the first month, written up by Friday?
Bob Chen: Sure, I'll have it by Friday.
Dan Park: One thing nobody has answered: who is on call for support during launch week? Last time it was unclear.
Ana Ruiz: Good point, I don't know yet. Let's figure that out next week.
Carla Diaz: Also, by the way, the new logo files are in the shared drive, the designer explained the grid system they used, it's based on an eight pixel baseline.
Ana Ruiz: Nice. And we agreed last month to only launch in the US first, that still stands, no EU until Q1.
Dan Park: Makes sense.
Ana Ruiz: Ok, that's it, thanks everyone.
